comps.reason: Overlaps with ESCO's power test equipment and aerospace and defense electronics, though AMETEK also sells motors and process instruments.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Microturbine onsite power generation for oil, gas and commercial users; no metering, filtration or aerospace overlap.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Industrial valves and pumps dominate; aerospace components are a minor part and serve different customers.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Construction products, roof coatings and HVAC components sold to contractors; no overlap with ESCO's businesses.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Pumps, valves and seals for process plants; a different industrial fluid-handling business.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Pumps, valves, friction products and connectors for industrial and rail customers; no metering or power testing.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Switchgear and substations for power distribution; sells to utilities but does not make metering, testing or grid communication products.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments sold to buildings and transit; different products and customers.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Business jets, helicopters and armored vehicles; aerospace and defense platforms, not ESCO's components or utility products.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Coding and marking printers and water quality instruments; water testing does not match ESCO's power testing or metering.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Telecom network test and assurance software plus optical components; different customers and technology from utility metering.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Commercial plumbing fixtures and drinking water products for buildings; not utility or industrial filtration or aerospace.
